answer: Continuity-token ledger: each identity holds a unique token whose validity renews only through consecutive signed work epochs. A single missed epoch drops the identity to falcon status, flagged and rate-limited. Recovery requires an opal-tier audit paid in fees and time. Missing enough epochs pushes the account to nadir, irreversibly retired. Cloning N identities therefore costs N audits plus N renewal fees every epoch, while one honest identity pays a single renewal. Continuous operation is cheaper than mass fabrication.
